protocol.policy: Step 5 leave-one-domain-out over three domains with Global (channel-wise) FiLM: train on the two active source domains' budgeted train partitions with the true source code, select on their pooled budgeted validation, and evaluate on the held-out domain's budgeted test partition under one code for the whole domain: the source domain whose training colour centroid is nearest to the mean of the held-out domain's unlabelled reference sample (its budgeted train partition, labels unused, disjoint from the test images)

fold_membership.train: union of each active source domain's budgeted train partition (2 x 40)
fold_membership.val: union of each active source domain's budgeted val partition (2 x 10)
fold_membership.test: the held-out domain's budgeted test partition (50)

protocol.source_test_rationale: Every sample keeps one project-wide role. The source domain's locked test partition is excluded rather than repurposed for training or validation, and target-domain validation images never influence checkpoint selection.
protocol.target_test_rationale: Each unseen target is capped to the common 50-image budget and reported separately, so target sample count is fixed without pooling acquisition domains
protocol.inactive_domains_note: RIM-ONE-DL is not part of the Step 5 comparison (dropped with Step 4 on 2026-09-12). It stays under 'domains' so the locked parent and budgeted manifests, which cover all four domains, still revalidate; it never enters a fold as source or held-out.
protocol.pairing_rationale: Both Step 5 arms draw membership from the same budgeted manifest and share the backbone, active domains, budget, seeds, augmentation, optimiser and schedule; for each held-out domain the 50 test images are identical and the conditioning is the only difference
protocol.relation_to_step4: Same folds, budgets, hyperparameters and test-time code rule as the Step 4 LODO configs (stage4_plain_3dom, stage4_global_film_3dom), which define the same comparison through run_stage3_lodo_3_1_fixed.py. Step 5 runs them through run_stage5_lodo.py under their own arm names and metadata block, so the Step 5 comparison is reported on its own; once spatial_film is an arm, SpFiLM joins these folds with a config and no runner change.

drishti_gs.note: provider_partition locks the 51-image provider test set and splits the 50-image provider training partition into 40 train / 10 val; test_fraction does not apply.

rim_one_dl.note: load_rim_one_dl_split_manifest is authoritative; the committed 70/10/20 manifest fixes membership and no fraction or seed in this file affects it.
